resources.string: Yana gano danna wasu takamaiman maɓallai a kan na’urar sarrafa nesa ɗinka kuma yana sake sanya su zuwa wani maɓalli ko manhaja, sannan yana lura da wace manhaja ce ke kan allo domin maɓalli ɗaya ya iya aiki daban a manhajar TV. Ba a taɓa adana dannawar maɓalli ko aika ta ko’ina ba.

MX3 Button Mapper yana amfani da Accessibility Service API na Android don sake sanya maɓallan na’urar sarrafa nesa ɗinka.

Idan an kunna shi, yana:
• Karanta dannawar maɓallai daga na’urar sarrafa nesa ɗinka, domin ya iya maye gurbin wasu takamaiman maɓallai da wani maɓalli daban, jerin dannawa, ko buɗe manhaja
• Lura da sunan manhajar da ke kan allo a halin yanzu, domin maɓalli (misali Tasha sama/ƙasa) ya iya yin wani abu daban a cikin manhajar TV

Ba ya karanta abin da ke kan allo, rubutu, ko kalmomin sirri. Ana amfani da dannawar maɓalli da sunayen manhajoji ne kawai a kan wannan na’ura, a lokacin da suka faru. Ba a taɓa adana su ba (sai dai idan ka kunna bayanan gyara matsala da ke ƙasa), kuma ba a taɓa raba su ko aika su waje da na’urar ba. Wannan manhaja ba ta da damar shiga intanet.

Idan ka yarda, manhajar za ta yi amfani da %1$s don kunna sabis ɗin samun damar ta da kanta. Kana iya kashe shi a kowane lokaci a Saituna → Samun dama.
Ka’idar da aka tsara zuwa wannan maɓallin (%1$s) ba a sanya shi ba
Ba a shigar da app ba
Shiga kowane latsa maɓalli (don magance matsala kawai)
Shiga latsa maɓallin da aka gyara (don magance matsala kawai)
%1$s farawa/tsaida intent auth token (manna cikakken ‘auth: XXXX’ daga allon %1$s’s View intents)
Ba da izinin %1$s, sannan kunna wannan sabis ɗin ƙarƙashin Samun damar
Alamar TV (yana shafar maɓallin %1$s TV musamman)
